meta.title: What income puts you in the global top 10% / 1% / 0.1%?
meta.units: international-$ PER MONTH (PIP: 2021 PPPs; WID: 2025 PPPs); converted from daily values at 365/12
notes: Thresholds are ENTRY incomes: the average income of the marginal country-bin when bins are sorted by income and population is accumulated to the target global share.
Population concept is basis-matched (mld.py convention): per-adult series rank the world's ADULTS (WID adult populations); per-capita series rank all people (WID total populations).
Computed over the common sample of countries present in both PIP and WID.
